Name: Curvy Redux - A Fantasy Femme Mod
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
My first attempt at reviving onyonechris's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8199]Curvy Girl[/url] mod was a bit of a flop, it was little more than a band-aid to get it working in 1.6. I now can bring you a cleaner, more comprehensive revival! Now with Fashion Sense integration and no more JA dependency!

This mod will give you options to modify your farmer in various ways﻿. You can now have:

- vanilla or curvy body types!
﻿***As of 1.3.3, you can choose to have the curvy body even when playing as a male!

﻿***As of 1.3.3, there are 4 body configs:
﻿  ﻿-vanilla (no explanation needed)
﻿  ﻿-curvy MTF Top PO (post op): This option gives you b**bs and a p*nis
﻿  ﻿-curvy MTF Bottom PO: This gives you pecs and a v*gina
﻿  ﻿-curvy femme (the original fully female curvy body)

﻿***As of 1.3.3 you can also choose:
﻿  ﻿-full coverage undies
﻿  ﻿-Top covered only
﻿  ﻿-Bottom covered only
﻿  ﻿-fully nude

﻿***You can also choose:
﻿  ﻿-hair: whether you have a strip of hair "down there"
﻿  ﻿-Bald: the opposite

[b]*Note that for now these are most immersive when using the FS clothing included in this mod[/b]
 
- a variety of eye styles; choose from angry, anime, anime 2, cyclops, emo, emo 2, insect, slanted, slanted small brows, sleepy, and smaller
- a variety of noses; choose from vanilla, button, hawk, honker, long, or no nose at all
- a variety of ears; choose from downward, elf, longer elf, mermaid, pixie, or human
- an option for an oval face or a more prominent chin
- a choice of fairy or feather wings in various colors
- a mermaid's tail in various colors!
(These options are all available from the config or GMCM!)

For the Fashion Sense aspect, you get:

- 500+ (!) shirts, all configured for both body types
- a variety of shoes such as regular boots, mountain boots, small shoes, shoes with socks, sandals, or even bare feet! All shoes are recolorable!
- various types of pants and skirts, all recolorable!
- a variety of recolorable sleeve types; you can choose bare arms, oversized sleeves, or any other sort of the included sleeves. Change it up for weather or season!

Mods required for this mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense

[/url]Optional mod for this mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23169]Swim - Continued[/url]

Future plans:
- [s]reintegrate the undies options[/s] Undies are back! No more surprise b**bies! Options are available via config
- [s]reintegrate sleeves options[/s] Sleeves and gloves are now reintegrated via Fashion Sense! Some are from the original mod and some are reconfigured curvy versions from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15431]SH's Gloves and Sleeves Pack[/url]
- [s]compatibility with the swim mod[/s] Swim mod is now compatible! Your farmer will wear a black bikini to go swimming! You can also now choose your mermaid tail from the config menu and it will stay on if you go swimming! For best results, choose "shells" under Top Undershirt and "merpants" under Bottom Underpants to live your best mermaid life!

***NOTE ON SWIM COMPAT: Swim - Continued has a known issue where there is a lack of running animations while wearing the swimsuit. For Curvy Girl, this means arms and legs disappear while running in your swimsuit. I'm trying to find a solution, but in the meantime, turning off your running option while in your swimsuit (found in your Swim config file) would give you the best immersive play with this mod

***EXTRA NOTE: I'm aware of a bug where like one or two pixels on the farmer's right chest is not fully covered by the black bra and also won't change skin tone. I am unsure of how to fix this at this time. Believe me, it's driving me nuts. I hope to fix this sometime in the future

***XTRA NOTE 2: I haven't figured out how to remove the undershirt yet for the male farmer. My apologies. I hope to fix that soon.


[size=6][b][color=#cc0000][u]WHEN UPDATING THIS MOD DO NOT OVERWRITE YOUR OLD FILES. DO A FRESH INSTALL EVERY TIME.[/u][/color][/b][/size]


Enjoy!
